implementationBoundary.codebase: One codebase for dev, test and production; environment parameter files only; no environment forks.
implementationBoundary.deployment: Not performed in Phase 3. AFF-4 plans; AFF-5 authors and validates locally; deployment requires the later governed route.
implementationBoundary.authentication: Human-interactive Azure sign-in for deployment or an explicitly approved Azure runtime managed identity. GitHub OIDC and stored credentials are prohibited.
implementationBoundary.database: Every environment must set publicNetworkAccess to Disabled and prove private DNS before application enablement.

confirmedHumanDecisions.HD-001: New AI-focused Citadel landing zone composing ALZ foundation, Foundry Citadel layered AI governance and Sovereign Landing Zone policy overlays.
confirmedHumanDecisions.HD-002: Separate Citadel management, connectivity and AI-governance subscriptions plus Stratton nonproduction, production and Internal Audit assurance subscriptions.
confirmedHumanDecisions.HD-003: Two-region pattern with regional AI only; exact region names pending.
confirmedHumanDecisions.HD-004: Enterprise hub-connected spokes, central DNS and enterprise IPAM; exact addresses/connections pending.
confirmedHumanDecisions.HD-005: Evidence-led elastic sizing and first-three-deal benchmark; exact caps pending.

proposedModuleBoundaries.notes: Consume exact parent and subscription IDs; never collapse governance, workload or assurance.
Pin the Foundry Citadel source revision; document every adaptation; deny Global/DataZone AI.
Fail if owner/costCenter/location evidence is absent.
Consumes Network Lead IPAM/WAN inputs; no CIDR default.
Central ownership is confirmed; duplicate workload zones are denied.
Role assignment executor is separate from application deployer.
No Stratton source documents, production inference or Internal Audit verdict.
Retention and incident endpoints are required parameters.

Public access disabled. SQL Local or Zone backup redundancy is required after approved-region capability evidence; Geo and GeoZone are denied because they use an implicit paired region. The value applies to STR/LTR and changes affect future backups only. Controlled ZRS-to-ZRS replication only; exact region pair required.

Create and approve the API Management private endpoint and prove central private DNS before disabling public network access. No public gateway fallback. Primary/recovery configuration and queue limits derive from benchmark.
Global/DataZone denied; exact regions, model/version/quota and provider evidence have no defaults.
Internal environments; primary active and recovery warm; images by immutable digest.

No public frontend IP and no fallback. Block planning until Microsoft.Network/EnableApplicationGatewayNetworkIsolation registration is evidenced for every target subscription; failover uses enterprise-controlled private DNS.
Internal Audit-approved executor only; delivery cannot grant itself access.

releaseSequenceConstraints: Treat HD-001 through HD-005 as confirmed patterns; obtain only their listed exact fail-closed parameters.
Establish Citadel management groups, separated platform/workload subscriptions and ALZ/AI/sovereignty policy composition before workload resources.
Pin and review the Azure-Samples Foundry Citadel source revision; preserve its status as an adapted architecture rather than a product dependency.
Establish both approved regional hubs, central DNS, identity and location policy before data or AI services.

Register and evidence Microsoft.Network/EnableApplicationGatewayNetworkIsolation in each target subscription before planning private-only Application Gateway resources; never substitute a public frontend.

Set and evidence Azure SQL requestedBackupStorageRedundancy before data admission; production allows only Local or Zone after regional capability evidence and never silently accepts the Geo/GeoZone default.
Approve the API Management private endpoint and prove central private DNS before setting publicNetworkAccess=Disabled; never restore the public gateway for recovery or troubleshooting.
Establish audit, immutable evidence and Internal Audit boundary before acceptance evidence is produced.
Enable source connectors only after source, permission, licence, privacy, retention and location evidence passes.
Enable AI analysis only after model/version/provider terms and AI governance evidence pass.
Use synthetic data through development and test.
Run first three eligible production deals in parallel with reconciliation and explicit go/no-go records.
Stop admission after twenty completed eligible deals pending human acceptance.
